notes: This programme is a selective BUT (3 years; quote: "3 ans"; 80 places in 2026). The pages do not explicitly state that this programme's teaching language is French; the only language-related quote for this programme is the required French level of B2 ("Niveau de français requis pour s'inscrire à la formation : B2"), so teachingLanguages is inferred from that and the French-language context (BUT/Université de Lorraine), and should be verified. Tuition: for a non-EU (extra-communautaire) student registering for the first time in a Licence cycle, Campus France Maroc states "2 902 euros pour une année en cycle de Licence", which applies to this BUT (bac+3); however, that page also says some institutions exempt foreign students ("Certains établissements exonèrent les étudiants étrangers du paiement des frais d'inscription différenciés.") and the Parcoursup page states "178 euros" per year for EU students, so the amount to pay may depend on an exemption to be checked with the institution. No intake/dates or document list specific to this programme could be quoted. environment variables are not available at runtime. Corrections: teachingLanguages is derived from the required B2 French level, not an explicit statement of the teaching language. The tuition figure comes from the general Campus France Maroc page for a Licence year, not from this programme's own page (which only gives the EU/EEA fee of 178 EUR and 0 for scholarship holders). ApplicationChannel is recorded in the notes: for a Moroccan Bac holder, applications go through Études en France (Model Codes).
